 Halle Berry learns fate in bitter custody battle with ex Olivier Martinez after explosive abuse claims 
 By 
 Nate Grant , 
 Sarah Jones and 
 Bernie Zilio 
 Published 
 Oct. 29, 2026, 1:18 p.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Halle Berry has learned her fate in her bitter custody battle with ex-husband Olivier Martinez, who accused her of abusing their 13-year-old son, Maceo.
 On Thursday, Los Angeles Superior Court Judge Shelley Kaufman lifted the temporary restrictions imposed on Berry and tossed out Martinez’s request for a domestic violence restraining order .
 Martinez will retain the custody order that was put in place when the temporary restraining order was granted , while he and Berry will continue to share legal custody.
 “We are extremely pleased that the Court has dissolved the TRO,” Berry’s attorney, Marina Beck, told Page Six exclusively. “As we move forward, Halle is determined to continue to focus on the well-being and best interests of her family.”
 A source added, “This is a huge win for Halle.”

 Martinez’s attorney did not immediately respond to our request for comment.
 Kaufman’s decision follows nearly four hours of sealed testimony from Maceo on Oct. 19, the first day of the hearing, as his therapist and a school official also took the stand.
 Berry and Martinez testified, too, with the latter storming out of the courtroom and using profanity as he appeared agitated and upset by the closed-door discussions.
 Berry’s 18-year-old daughter, Nahla Aubry, and her fiancé, Van Hunt, also testified in a closed courtroom over the course of the nine-day proceeding.
 Aubry previously defended her mother in a court declaration, stating she was “shocked” by the abuse allegations and had never witnessed her behave aggressively toward her half-brother.
 Martinez, 60, accused Berry, also 60, of physically abusing Maceo in a domestic violence restraining order request in which he asked for sole physical and legal custody. Martinez claimed Berry choked their son during a Sept. 26 altercation.

 Kaufman granted Martinez’s request for a temporary protective order on Oct. 1.
 Berry, meanwhile, has consistently denied the allegations detailed in the filing.
 “There is voluminous evidence, including numerous judicial rulings, that Olivier Martinez repeatedly violated court orders and interfered with necessary therapeutic and educational interventions to the detriment of his and Halle Berry’s minor son, Maceo – misconduct for which Mr. Martinez has already been legally sanctioned,” her attorney previously told Page Six .
 The “Monster’s Ball” star had asked the judge to deny Martinez’s restraining order request and lift the temporary restrictions .

 6 
 Berry’s fiancé, Van Hunt, was by her side during the proceedings (pictured). David Buchan for Page Six 
 She accused the French actor of escalating their custody dispute and interfering with their son’s educational and therapeutic needs.
 Berry sought sole legal custody of Maceo – giving her final say over his health, education and welfare – while proposing they continue alternating weeks with him.
 The Oscar winner and Martinez  were married  from July 2013 until  their separation  two years later. They were declared legally single in December 2016 before  finalizing their divorce  in August 2023.
